title: a check runs only when the change reaches what its green runs were observed to use, and the pipeline builds, runs and records on one instrumented debug build
scope:
how the acceptance sweep, `bun nv verify`, `bun nv affected` and `bun nv proofs` choose
what to start, what they record, and which `nvs` they run. It does not change what a check asks, how
a check is judged, the plan's shape or the floor gate's cadence.
